content: दय् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (दयते, दयित) .²1 To feel pity or compassion for, pity, sympathise with (with <ab>gen.</ab>); रामस्य दयमानो ऽसावध्येति तव लक्ष्मणः <ls>Bk. 8. 119</ls>; तेषां दयसे न कस्मात् <ls n="Bk.">2. 33</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 63</ls>. .²2 To love, like, be fond of; दयमानाः प्रमदाः <ls>Ś. 1. 4</ls>; <ls>Bk. 10. 9</ls>. .²3 To protect; नगजा न गजा दयिता दयिताः <ls>Bk. 10. 9</ls>. .²4 To go, move. .²5 To grant, give, divide or allot. .²6 To hurt.
